name: train-cs-sk-focal-s1
description:
RQ6, first full run: GLiNER multilingual fine-tuned for Czech and Slovak names and
addresses with gliner's focal loss weighted towards the positive spans (alpha 0.75, gamma 2).
Every CNEC 2.0 and UNER Slovak-SNK train example and 10,000 drawn from each OpenPII 1M
train split; 2,000 steps of 16 (about 1.4 passes; batches of 16 train 1.26 times as
fast as batches of 8 on the M4 Pro). Its twin config differs only in the loss.
